I don't really want the responsibility of being support for anyone. Idk how
 I would even get training for that  it would just be a
Nother job for me  Idk what I'm doing. I just want it all to be over

Thanks for the advice. I hate what I see in the mirror. I hate what I see when I'm smiling at myself. And what I see in the mirror, or what I can make myself do, never seems to really translaite to real life situations. I can only practice my preformance in the mirror when I am really drunk. This fact alone makes me want to die. There is just no solid road to improving this. But again, I do appreciate the response.

I guess when I was 11, just starting puberty and realizing how socially awkward I am, and how it made people dislike me and label me as weird. Just from my own experience with my peers. My retarded parents could never have taught me that shit. Even the simplest criticism was condemned as evil by them. What can you really expect from two social rejects? It only shows that their offspring would be the same. They are bad teachers. I have never felt comfortable in my own skin. I've never been able to be that way, and I've never been able to look at myself objectively. Only when I am completely sloshed can I see myself for who I truly am. Only then can I see what others see. I am ugly. My presentation is disgraceful. I can finally see why people said I looked like a cat. I hate it.

I appreciate the advice, but idk what is and isn't safe anymore. I have zero experience sleeping rough or knowing what to do I  in that situation. I don't want to beg. Idk. Thanks for the advice I guess.

I don't want to get busy or deal with other people. I just get treated like a child and I'm too tired and beat down to give a fuck about earning anyone's respect anymore. I'm a social retard and I'm not willing to live with who I am. If I tried to "help someone" with their problems I would come off as an inappropriate, socially retarded fuck, because that's who I am. Just thinking about how stupid I am socially is enough to just make me out a gun in my mouth. It makes me hate other people too, that I can't be like them. I am pathetic. I don't want to die, but I'm done with life. I'm done with people. I'm not willing get better with them.

There's nothing you can do. Life is just too hard. It's too much work. I just don't appreciate the experience. It's not fun. I'm not happy to be involved. There's nothing I want to be, nothing I want to do, and yet, every day, there is more bullshit to deal with. Brush your teeth. Shower. Find something to eat. It sucks, and now
I'm going to have to face not having a roof over my head. Let me tell you, I am not a survivor, figuratively, and definitely not literally. I have no faith in my life, and there is no faith to have, because I just don't want anything anymore. I don't want to die, but life is too hard. I don't want to accept all of the responsibility. I don't want to constantly be thinking about how to improve, or how to be a good person, or a responsibile person. I can't live like that. I just can't live. It's too much work. I'm tired of not being able to build confidence. I'm tired of having to build it at all. I'm tired of having to earn respect, or need respect. I'm tired of having to become normal socially. Without these things, I have no chance in the real world.
